tests.name: T11_metacell_level_vectors_persisted
tests.requirement: the substrate carries metacell-level vectors, not only donor means
tests.detail: metacell-level RNA and ATAC vectors plus per-metacell depth are all persisted, so Stage 4 need not reopen the matrices

tests.name: T12_phase_B_computes_no_two_modality_statistic
tests.requirement: Phase B may look at one modality at a time but never couples them
tests.detail: single-modality and depth terms permitted; correlation reserved

tests.name: T13_enumeration_rows_change_no_population
tests.requirement: ENUMERATION_ONLY rows do not alter retention, N or the primary population
tests.detail: 57 extra rows recomputed independently; retention and N unchanged

tests.name: T14_recoverability_firewall_precisely_scoped
tests.requirement: the recoverability split does not silently shrink the Phase-B population
tests.detail: split scoped to recoverability selection only; Phase B keeps its own donor-population authority

tests.name: T15_no_protected_obs_column_read
tests.requirement: only donor identity and cell type were read; demographics were not
tests.detail: only ['SampleID', 'cell_type'] read; all 7 protected demographic columns declared excluded

tests.name: T16_no_statistical_decision_changed
tests.requirement: the substrate contract changes no statistical decision
tests.detail: statistically neutral and bound to the accepted V3 digest

tests.name: T17_every_enumeration_rule_has_upstream_authority
tests.requirement: no inferential rule is introduced by the substrate contract (S58)
tests.detail: all 3 rules have upstream authority and the statistical contract declares the decision as its own

tests.name: T18_enumeration_denominator_recomputed
tests.requirement: the fraction denominator tracks the artifact and is not a literal (S57)
tests.detail: denominator 24,187 recomputed from the artifact and the fraction follows from it
